heroHeadline: Artemis II Crew in Ottawa with PM Carney; IFT-12 Retargets May 19; House Appropriates $24.4B for NASA
heroSubtitle: May 13: All four Artemis II crew members (Wiseman, Glover, Koch, Hansen) are in Ottawa for a full day of Canadian Space Agency-hosted events — a meeting with PM Mark Carney, a visit to the Canadian Museum of Nature with school students, and a sold-out 'Meet the Crew' event at the National Arts Centre. The Ottawa visit is the crew's first trip to Canada since the April 1–10 mission, highlighting the historic role of Canadian astronaut Jeremy Hansen — the first non-American on a lunar trajectory. Simultaneously, the House Appropriations full committee marked up the FY2027 CJS bill at $24.438 billion for NASA — flat with FY2026 and a decisive rejection of the White House's proposed 23% cut ($18.8B); the Exploration account received $8.926B (+$1.1B). The crew visited senators on Capitol Hill on May 12, the day before the markup vote. IFT-12 (Starship V3 — Booster 19 + Ship 39): SpaceX did not use the May 12 opening window, retargeting NET May 19 at 5:30 PM CDT (window May 15–21); the V3 debut will test docking port and propellant-transfer hardware critical for Artemis III HLS qualification. Day 33 post-splashdown: Orion visual heat shield inspection continues at KSC's Multi-Payload Processing Facility; formal Marshall X-ray scans remain on track for summer 2026. Artemis Accords at 67 nations.
